facts.business: Garment Mantra Lifestyle Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of textile products, operating as an export-driven enterprise in the textile and garment manufacturing segment.
key_risks: Volatility in prices of cotton, yarn and other raw materials
Intense competition from domestic as well as international manufacturers
Global economic uncertainties affecting export demand
Increasing labour and logistics costs impacting profitability
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions were in the ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis. The Company has obtained prior approval of the Audit Committee for entering into any transaction with related parties. The Audit Committee has granted omnibus approval for certain transactions to be entered into with the related parties, during the year.
